about_the_game:
🕹️ Gameplay System

  • Players are divided into two sides:

    • Kid (1 player) – Chases the cats and tries to prevent them from wreaking havoc in the house.

    • Cats (Unlimited players) – Must destroy as many household items as possible while avoiding the kid!

  • Cat's Unique Skills:

    • Run on Two Legs – Temporarily increases speed.

    • Create a Decoy – Spawns a fake version of itself to trick the kid.

    • Fart Stun – Releases a stinky fart that stuns the kid for a short period.

  • Kid's Unique Skills:

    • Ball Shooter – Shoots balls to slow down the cats.

    • Run on All Fours – Temporarily boosts movement speed.

    • Ghost Mode – Turns into a ghost, allowing passage through walls.

Time-Based System: If time runs out before the kid catches all the cats or if the cats destroy enough objects, the cats win!

🎮 Stunning Graphics with Unreal Engine 5

  • A destructible house with realistic physics! Watch furniture break and debris fly as the cats unleash chaos.

  • Realistic lighting and shadows bring the house to life, making it feel warm yet filled with chaos.

  • Highly detailed cat animations, including jumping, scratching, and rolling, making every movement look natural.
